competitors.scope: The linked story and its complete public comment tree, including replies, plus user-requested Rustwright, Rustwright MCP and Biloba. Additional stories are recorded separately from comments on the original thread. This is not a search of every Hacker News submission.

tools.label: Bruster / WebKitGTK
tools.notes: Native JSONL; system WebKitGTK and Xvfb. Reference implementation.

tools.label: Playwright / Headless Shell
tools.notes: Public Playwright API; separate Headless Shell configuration.

tools.label: Puppeteer / full Chrome
tools.notes: Existing baseline; not named in the linked HN thread.

tools.label: agent-browser / full Chrome
tools.notes: Native CLI and persistent daemon; per-command CLI overhead included.

tools.label: Stagehand / full Chrome
tools.notes: Local v4 SDK and bundled extension; deterministic Page APIs. No LLM calls, act/extract inference, cloud caching, or token-efficiency claims.

tools.label: browse.sh / full Chrome
tools.notes: Local browse CLI, Stagehand extension and persistent daemon; per-command Node CLI overhead included. Same monorepo as Stagehand.

tools.label: Playwright MCP / full Chrome
tools.notes: Actual stdio MCP server and tool calls, including default response snapshots and client/server overhead; navigation explicitly waits for load.

tools.label: SleepyHollow / Apple WebKit
tools.notes: Separate same-Mac Bruster/SleepyHollow timing job and artifact. Requires macOS 12+ and WebKit.framework. No Linux/PSS or runtime-footprint estimates; native validation requires the macOS workflow.

tools.label: Cypress / Chrome test runner
tools.notes: Real Cypress CLI/spec runner, application iframe, proxy and task IPC; one command per test with test isolation and retries disabled. Runner, bundled Electron runtime and owned Xvfb are counted. Native snapshot is unavailable; shared DOM extraction is measured.

tools.label: Ui.Vision MCP / browser extension
tools.notes: Official browser extension and real MCP bridge in an isolated headless Chrome profile with an open panel. Playwright provisions/closes the browser; measured operations use MCP. Macro-log extraction is chunked to respect transport limits; all calls and default response snapshots are counted. Native snapshots can truncate at 60,000 characters; shared extraction is complete.

tools.label: Rustwright / full Chrome
tools.notes: User-requested addition, verified against separate HN stories identifying Skyvern-AI/rustwright. Public Node SDK over its in-process Rust CDP engine. The experimental Node API lacks a viewport setter: a CDP connection provisions the viewport at startup and remains idle in memory scope. All workload operations use the SDK. Native snapshot is unavailable in the Node SDK.

tools.label: Rustwright MCP / full Chrome
tools.notes: User confirmed that 'Rust MCP' means Rustwright MCP. Canonical native Rust stdio MCP server, launched directly from its official npm binary package. MCP client/server and automatic snapshots are counted; navigation explicitly waits for load. Native snapshots can truncate; shared extraction is complete. Distinct from the deprecated Python server and luka-loehr/browser-rs.

tools.label: Biloba / full Chrome
tools.notes: User-requested addition, verified against its separate Show HN story. Public TypeScript SDK and real bilobad Go daemon over chromedp; a fresh local browser and session per round. Measures serial browser operations, including daemon transport; no Vitest/Ginkgo scheduling or parallel-suite claims. Native accessibility outlines can truncate; shared extraction is complete.

related_mentions.name: Jev / TypeSafe
related_mentions.notes: Typed decision model integrated with Stagehand, not a browser runtime. The verified GitHub link is the integration PR; no standalone Jev browser repository was identified. Requires a model-driven accuracy/cost evaluation.

related_mentions.name: Browserbase
related_mentions.notes: Hosted browser service; this is its client SDK, not the hosted browser source. Cloud/network latency needs a separate comparison.

related_mentions.name: Codex
related_mentions.notes: Coding-agent harness using browser tools, not a browser backend.

related_mentions.name: Claude Code
related_mentions.notes: Coding-agent product repository, not an open-source browser backend.

related_mentions.name: Deep Agents
related_mentions.notes: Agent harness; browser tools and model must be specified for an end-to-end task evaluation.

related_mentions.name: Mastra
related_mentions.notes: Agent framework, not a browser runtime.

related_mentions.name: Eve
related_mentions.notes: Vercel agent framework, identified through Stagehand's Eve integration and the eve npm package repository. Uses a browser integration rather than implementing a browser.

related_mentions.name: Fx
related_mentions.notes: Coding agent, identified through Stagehand's fx integration and fx.sh's repository link. Uses the Stagehand MCP integration for browser tasks.

related_mentions.name: Astra computer use
related_mentions.notes: Computer-use/model alternative, with no repository linked in the thread. No authoritative standalone browser repository identified; unrelated projects with the same name are not substituted. Requires a specified model and computer-use environment.

metadata.common_extraction_js:
(() => ({
  title: document.title,
  elements: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,p,li,a,input,button,select,textarea'))
    .filter(e => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; })
    .map(e => ({tag: e.tagName.toLowerCase(),
      name: (e.getAttribute('aria-label') || e.getAttribute('placeholder') || e.textContent || '').trim(),
      href: e.getAttribute('href'), value: 'value' in e ? e.value : null}))
}))()
